_company_note: HF Sinclair Corp (HollyFrontier + Sinclair merger 14 mars 2022). Sources: 10-K 2023/2024/2025 Item 7 Refining Segment Operating Data.

kpis.signal: Recovery FY24 post turnarounds Puget Sound + Parco + Casper, integration Sinclair complete
kpis.description_fr: Barils par jour de brut traite dans les 7 raffineries consolidees (El Dorado, Tulsa, Puget Sound, Navajo, Woods Cross, Parco, Casper). Hero KPI raffineur.
kpis.description_en: Barrels per day of crude oil processed at 7 consolidated refineries (El Dorado, Tulsa, Puget Sound, Navajo, Woods Cross, Parco, Casper). Refiner hero KPI.

kpis.signal: Compression FY24 -50% vs FY23, retour vers normalisation post peak crack spreads 2022
kpis.description_fr: Marge brute par baril produit (sales price moins cost). Cycle hyper-cyclique. Peak FY22 $26.78 (post Ukraine), compression FY24 a $10.43.
kpis.description_en: Gross margin per barrel sold (sales price minus cost). Hyper-cyclical. FY22 peak $26.78 (post Ukraine), FY24 compression to $10.43.

kpis.signal: Recovery FY24 apres turnarounds FY23 (Mid-Continent 96.8%, West 83.8%)
kpis.description_fr: Taux d'utilisation des capacites de raffinage. FY23 bas (83.7%) du au turnarounds Puget Sound + Parco + Casper. Recovery FY24.
kpis.description_en: Refinery capacity utilization rate. FY23 low (83.7%) due to Puget Sound + Parco + Casper turnarounds. FY24 recovery.

kpis.signal: Throughput inclut brut + autres feedstocks (additifs, blendstocks)
kpis.description_fr: Total feedstocks entrants dans les unites de raffinage (brut + additifs). Plus large que crude charge. Step-up FY22 lie a integration Sinclair (14 mars 2022).
kpis.description_en: Total feedstocks entering refining units (crude + additives). Broader than crude charge. FY22 step-up from Sinclair integration (Mar 14 2022).

kpis.signal: Mix produits FY24 : 52% gasolines, 31% diesel, 6% jet, 4% base oils (lubricants)
kpis.description_fr: Volume de produits raffines vendus (gasoline, diesel, jet, asphalte, base oils). Le 0.5% de difference avec throughput = pertes/intra-consommation.
kpis.description_en: Volume of refined products sold (gasoline, diesel, jet, asphalt, base oils). 0.5% gap vs throughput = losses/internal use.
